scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the expected Si 2p₃/₂ binding energy (linear interpolation) and N 1s shift (partial charge model) from the agent-reported bonding unit string using the same constants as in the paper; no pre‑stored gold table is needed.

outputs.description: Computed binding energies and N 1s shifts for the 15 Si-centered tetrahedra. Values are deterministic given the public constants; comparison to hidden gold tolerates a small absolute deviation.

steps.description: Verify that all 15 computed EB_Si2p3_2 and deltaEB_N1s match the expected values (recomputed from the paper’s rules) within 0.02 eV.
